Alex: Quick heads-up — onboarding orionlite (Llama->Mistral hybrid export) int4. Small prompts ok, but after ~200 tokens it starts emitting lots of <unk> and repeats. Seen longctx regressions tied to vocab remap before?

Priya: Which converter path did you use? new `modelx/convert.py` or legacy `vocab_merger`? Any normalisation step?

Alex: modelx/convert.py + --quant=int4 --rotary-scale=1.0. Ran NFKC. Repro log:
```
[2026-03-22 14:02:11] INFO step=198 token=412 logp=-2.9
[2026-03-22 14:02:12] INFO step=199 token=0 logp=-11.7
[2026-03-22 14:02:12] WARN token 0 appears repeatedly; dropping output quality
```

Luca: token=0 suggests pad/EOS/UNk collision during remap. Did the converter drop low-freq tokens and shift indices? Also check for invisible whitespace tokens (NBSP U+00A0, ZWSP U+200B) that sometimes map to 0 if not present in new vocab.

Alex: Converter had `prune_low_freq=True` by default. Original vocab head: `['<pad>','<unk>','\u00A0','the','to','a','is','\u200B']` — notice NBSP at idx 2 and ZWSP at idx 7. After conversion, NBSP vanished and indices shifted.

Priya: Oof. That will break any code assuming stable reserved slots. Our kv-cache and some runtime optimisations assume pad=0 and that reserved tokens don't get reassigned. Also check rotary implementation: we had a fallback path that used token_id%head_dim in an old shim — if token ids shift, rotary phase will warp mid-sequence.

Luca: Yup. I remember a bug where per-head rotary scaling was precomputed using original token ids for cached keys; remapping invalidates that. Symptoms: clean until first remapped token, then sharp delta in logp.

Alex: Re-ran with `--prune_low_freq=False` and forced `--preserve_reserved` mapping in convert.py. Perplexities on validation chat: baseline=13.1, converted-pruned=22.4, converted-preserve=13.3. Longctx regression disappeared.

Priya: Nice. Can you paste the small repro snippet you used to test longctx? Command people can run.

Alex: Sure:
```
# reproduce
python -m tests.longctx_repro --model orionlite_conv \
  --prompt-file tests/long_prompts.txt --max-tokens 400 --seed 42
```

Luca: Two follow-ups: 1) add a converter-lint that errors if any invisible/control whitespace token would be reindexed to 0 or collide with pad/unk/eos, 2) add an eval for rotational continuity: run 3 seeds, compare mean logp over sliding windows up to 512 tokens, fail on >0.5 mean-delta.

Priya: Also validate head-dims: if model export changes head layout (e.g., head-splitting or merge), we need a head-mapping table so rotary/headwise precompute indexes map to new ids. Add a sanity check in runtime that asserts rotary lookup is monotonic or provides a mapping warning.
